timing_semantics.commitment_time_ms: cold native KZG commitment work only, including first-use static-base preparation invoked inside commitment; Taylor-shift coefficient materialization is excluded
timing_semantics.proof_size_bytes: actual canonical serialized mechanism proof bytes
timing_semantics.prove_time_ms: native online proof work, Taylor-shift coefficient materialization, and canonical proof encoding, excluding KZG commitment work and artifact file I/O

formulae.aggregate: compute each pair first, then report mean and sample standard deviation over n=3

limitations: No claim is made that all 66 proofs passed a second independent verification.
Three repetitions are descriptive; no statistical significance is claimed.
The measurements are mechanism-level proof costs, not end-to-end GAT proof performance.
